proposalRationale:
TJR draw-on-liquidity level set: 1-hour, 4-hour and session highs and lows.

CLASSIFICATION: SOURCE-STATED enumeration; INCOMPLETE as a specification. 1 supporting evidence
item, 0 contradicting. Proposed separately from the target rule because this level set is a shared
primitive -- the same set feeds target selection (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|029), the step-1 liquidity
sweep that starts the setup (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|008), and the leading-index test
(CLAIM|TJR|20260727|005). Specifying it once is worth more than specifying it three times.

MECHANICAL SPECIFICATION: aggregate the instrument to H1, H4 and session buckets; for each
completed bucket in the lookback window emit its high and its low, located at the wick extreme per
CLAIM|TJR|20260727|065; session buckets use New York time per CLAIM|TJR|20260727|055. The result is
a timestamped, deduplicated level set. This part is fully deterministic and testable today.

DATA REQUIRED: H1 and H4 OHLC series plus session boundaries. All obtainable from a single M1 or
M30 series by aggregation; no external feed needed.

FALSIFICATION: generate the level set for a date TJR has charted and compare against the levels he
actually marked. Levels he marks that are absent from the generated set refute the enumeration's
completeness; generated levels he visibly ignores point at the missing eligibility filter rather
than at the enumeration.

UNKNOWN: (a) LOOKBACK WINDOW -- unstated, and blocking, as above; (b) whether daily and weekly
highs/lows are also draws -- the enumeration reads as exhaustive but is never stated to be, and
CLAIM|TJR|20260727|010 (mark out the session opens as the first daily preparation step) suggests
session OPENS are also marked levels, which this enumeration omits entirely; (c) whether the
already-swept filter of CLAIM|TJR|20260727|011 applies to all three level classes or only to
session levels -- |011 mentions only session highs and lows.
